title: 第182章 “是我引诱了她。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

冷软的唇只是轻轻点在了男人的脸上。

是比花瓣还要柔软的，香冽的触感。

男人原本是垂眸看向宋瓷摆弄他袖扣的那只手的。

所以，当那个甚至算不上吻的吻落下来时，男人眸光微顿，瞳孔稍凝。

拇指摩挲过食指的指腹，只是力道似乎有些大，显现出几分不太正常的白。

只是一瞬，他调整了情绪，微微抬眸，视线落在了少女的脸上。

一旁的少女似乎不觉得自己做了什么惊天动地的大事，亲过祝砚铮的脸，转而看向面前的方喻之，微微挑眉。

唇角带着几分不加掩饰的挑衅，她如愿看到了面前两人眼中的骇然与震惊。

“还需要我继续证明给你看吗？”

少女声音轻软乖顺，一双水眸晃荡着，不带半分杂质。

方喻之瞪大了眼睛，嘴巴微微张开，看向两人的眼神满是震撼与不可置信。

“宋、宋瓷……”

他张张嘴，叫了宋瓷的名字，却又一时间不知道该说些什么。

视线从两人身上逡巡而过，蓦地，方喻之像是想起什么。

——所以，那天雨夜，电话里的那些声音是……是他们在一起？

所以宋瓷说不会跟他走，不是在赌气，是真的……不爱他了？

眼中是久久的怔神与茫然。

一旁的孟晚倒是比方喻之更早反应过来。

“宋瓷！你还要不要脸！？你们、你们是——”

他们是什么呢？

他们不是亲人，没有血亲，甚至……

连八竿子打不着的叔侄也算不上。

他们、他们是……

孟晚的声音小了下去，只是怒目圆睁，不甘又错愕地看向宋瓷。

宋瓷微扬眉骨，唇角带着清浅的笑意：“我们是，郎才女貌，天造地设的一对有情人。”

宋瓷的手还在无意识地摆弄着祝砚铮的袖扣。

男人另一只手虚虚地环住少女的腰身，微微垂眸，长睫下落下大片阴翳，如同漂亮的鸦羽。

“宋瓷，你不要脸！这是我的小叔！你凭什么跟他在一起！？”

“你不怕爷爷知道了，被你气倒吗！？”

“你这么做到底对得起谁！？”

说到这里，孟晚眼中闪过一抹光亮，如同福至心灵一般，她冷嗤一声，眯着眼看向宋瓷。

“啊，我懂了，”孟晚嗓音阴狠愤怒，“宋瓷，你是想要借此报复我对不对？”

“你以为你这样做，就能赢过我吗？”孟晚怒目圆睁，“宋瓷，少得意了！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The cold and soft lips just touched the man's face lightly.

It is softer than flower petals and has a fragrant touch.

The man originally lowered his eyes to look at Song Ci's hand playing with his cufflinks.

So, when the kiss that wasn't even a kiss fell, the man's eyes paused slightly and his pupils condensed slightly.

The thumb rubbed the pad of the index finger, but the force seemed a bit strong, showing a somewhat abnormal white color.

In just a moment, he adjusted his emotions, raised his eyes slightly, and his eyes fell on the girl's face.

The girl on the side didn't seem to think that she had done anything earth-shattering. She kissed Zhu Yanzheng's face, then turned to look at Fang Yuzhi in front of her, raising her eyebrows slightly.

There was a bit of undisguised provocation on the corner of her lips, and she saw the horror and shock in the eyes of the two people in front of her as she wished.

"Do you still need me to continue to prove it to you?"

The girl's voice was soft and obedient, and her watery eyes were swaying without any impurities.

Fang Yuzhi's eyes widened, his mouth opened slightly, and he looked at the two of them with shock and disbelief.

"Song, Song Ci..."

He opened his mouth and called Song Ci's name, but for a moment he didn't know what to say.

His eyes wandered past the two of them, and suddenly, Fang Yuzhi seemed to remember something.

——So, those voices on the phone that rainy night were... they were together?

So when Song Ci said she wouldn't leave with him, she wasn't out of anger, she really... didn't love him anymore?

There was a long period of confusion and confusion in his eyes.

Meng Wan on the side reacted earlier than Fang Yuzhi.

"Song Ci! Are you still shameless!? You, you are—"

What are they?

They are not relatives, not blood relatives, or even...

Not even uncles and nephews who can't be hit with eight poles.

They, they are...

Meng Wan's voice softened, but her eyes widened angrily, and she looked at Song Ci with reluctance and surprise.

Song Ci raised her eyebrows slightly, with a faint smile on her lips: "We are a talented man and a beautiful woman, a couple made in heaven."

Song Ci's hands were still playing with Zhu Yanzheng's cufflinks unconsciously.

The man's other hand weakly hugged the girl's waist, and he lowered his eyes slightly, with large shadows falling under his long eyelashes, like beautiful crow feathers.

"Song Ci, you are shameless! This is my uncle! Why are you with him!?"

"Aren't you afraid that grandpa will find out and be angry with you!?"

"Who are you worthy of by doing this!?"

Speaking of this, Meng Wan's eyes flashed with light, as if she was blessed with happiness in her soul. She sneered coldly and looked at Song Ci with squinted eyes.

"Ah, I understand," Meng Wan said in a sinister and angry voice, "Song Ci, you want to take this to retaliate against me, right?"

"Do you think you can beat me by doing this?" Meng Wan's eyes widened angrily, "Song Ci, don't be so proud!"
